title: Rescue crew from Air Station hoists fisherman in life raft
credit: Video by Air Station Cape Cod)" />
description: A rescue crew from Air Station Cape Cod hoisted a fisherman out of a lift raft after the fishing vessel Leonardo had capsized and sank off the coast of Martha's Vineyard, Massachusetts. A rescue swimmer was able to repel down to the man in the raft and assist him into the rescue basket. (Video by Air Station Cape Cod)
